## About
The Auto Shoppe is Randy Rodman's shop on Philadelphia Ave in Silver Spring. Randy is a Mercedes specialist, and that's the work we know best.
One customer keeps coming back for any kind of service on their Mercedes and recommends "Randy & son." A second reviewer called the shop a hidden gem with reasonable pricing. We're rated 4.4 on Google from 63 reviews.

## Services
- Mercedes service: Service work for Mercedes-Benz owners. One customer brings their Mercedes back for any kind of service needs.
- Fuel filler door assembly: One reviewer came in to have a fuel filler door assembly installed and was in and out.
